note: Rules a person wrote for what an option should not take as is. The types page checks every row of these options against them, in every language.

mpl/RawAesKeyring.wrapping_key.why: Text such as a password is not a key. Turning text into a key should take an explicit conversion.

esdk/decrypt.ciphertext.why: Ciphertext held as text is usually base64. Its bytes are not a message, so passing them as is fails.
